rationale: The 30h15m delay (scheduled 21:15 on July 20, actual 03:30 on July 22, per the carrier's report) was caused by flooding, which is a covered reason under Trip Delay in section 3 of wording 2026.1, and it passes the First plan's 3-hour waiting period. Meals with no receipts are paid at the flat $35 per traveler per 24 hours (or part of 24 hours) under section 10 of the claims manual, so 2 days x $35 = $70 instead of the $140 claimed, and the $85 rebooking fee is covered by a matching receipt. The total is $155, which is under the $1,000 sign-off limit and the First Trip Delay maximum of $1,500.
